description: Density altitude is the ICAO standard-atmosphere height with the same air density (FAA-H-8083-25C Chapter 11; ICAO Doc 7488 / ISO 2533). Pass pressure_altitude_ft and oat_c (or oat_f), or field_elevation_ft plus altimeter_inhg or altimeter_hpa. Dry air. Educational only, not for performance dispatch.

altimeter_inhg.description: Altimeter setting in inches of mercury

field_elevation_ft.description: Field elevation in feet, used with an altimeter setting

oat_f.description: Outside air temperature in °F (used if oat_c is omitted)

pressure_altitude_ft.description: Pressure altitude in feet (altimeter set to 29.92 inHg)

name: density_altitude
title: Density altitude from pressure altitude and temperature, or elevation and QNH
